notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.notes:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added "Gourmet" theme.
[*]Added blame tiles: Tripped and mis-flagged mines will now show the color of the player who made the mistake.
[*]The mine tripped that takes your last life now has a outlining "boom" graphic.
[*]Added drawing mode: You can now toggle a button in-game to enable drawing and erasing lines on the board.
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Drawing will disqualify Flagless attempts.
[*]The number cells on Dark Cosmic are no longer hollow.
[*]Professor Grey now teaches you about drawing.
[*]Professor Grey now teaches you about moving the camera.
[*]Adjusted position of settings title text and gave it a black outline for better readability.
[*]You can now flag and chord with spacebar.
[*]Adjusted colors of classic dark mode numbers.
[*]Adjusted pink glaggle's textures.
[*]Adjusted orange glaggle's textures.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed multiple players doing the first click at roughly the same time causing board desync.
[*]Fixed the border ever so slightly covering the board.
[*]In-game HUD buttons are now affected by dark mode.
[*]Fixed being able to interact with the board through the glaggles.
[*]The mine icons in board theme settings are now affected by dark mode.
[*]Fixed social buttons remaining visible while in a lobby.
[*]Fixed friends sometimes becoming yellow and their mouse becoming invisible.
[*]Fixed your mouse's current sprite persisting to the title screen until you click.
[/list]

notes.title: Minesweeper Together Out Now!
notes.notes:
[h2]Minesweeper Together v1.0.0[/h2]
[list]
[*]Play co-op with up to 3 friends or by yourself
[*]Try the tutorial if you're new or feeling rusty
[*]Earn up to 10 achievements
[*]Five selectable difficulties
[*]Set up to 10 lives
[*]Set the safety radius of your first click
[*]Toggleable "No Guessing" mode
[*]Set how long the no guessing algorithm computes for
[*]Select from nine different glaggles to play as
[*]Select from six different board themes
[*]Toggleable dark mode for each theme
[*]Select from 39 different backgrounds during gameplay or a random background each session
[*]Toggleable background animation
[/list]
